atlases.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent full-body felt puppet animation pose atlas, 4 figures in a strict equal 2-by-2 grid.
Create four NEW everyday acting poses of EXACTLY the Ichabod Crane character shown in the two reference images. The reference images are identity, costume, proportion, and material guides. Preserve his tall slender adult build, narrow long face and nose, brown hair tucked back, brown broad-brim hat, dark teal long coat, rust waistcoat, cream neckcloth, tan knee breeches, black stockings, brown buckled shoes, expressive warm brown eyes. Same handcrafted felt miniature look, stitching, tactile fibers, softly lit dimensional puppet. Same recognizable face in every cell.
All poses have CLOSED MOUTH or very subtle quiet conversational expression: none are singing. No large raised arm, no songbook.
Top-left: attentive neutral full-body standing pose, face and chest three-quarter toward camera-right, hands resting low at sides.
Top-right: calm teaching pose, small plain chalkboard slate held at waist level in one hand, other hand holding chalk and pointing gently at the slate; relaxed shoulders and closed mouth.
Bottom-left: quietly reading a small folded invitation held low at his waist, gaze downward, full-body standing, slight thoughtful smile.
Bottom-right: polite greeting full-body standing, one hand at his chest, slight courteous bow, other hand relaxed, hat on head, no book.
Composition: one complete figure centered within each equal rectangular quadrant, generous clear margins around hats, hands and shoes, generous totally transparent horizontal and vertical gutters. Uniform head size and body proportions in all four cells, same camera distance, feet aligned within each row. Every hat and every shoe fully inside its own quadrant. No overlap between quadrants.
Scene/backdrop: TRUE transparent alpha cutout background and transparent gutters, no environment, no floor or ground plane, no contact shadow, no checkerboard or opaque background, no text labels, no borders, no watermarks.
Use the exact reference character rather than redesigning him. No singing gestures in any cell.
atlases.inspection: Visually inspected. Identity and costume match; closed mouths throughout; all full figures visible. Greeting has a gentle smile, not singing. No visual anatomy issues.
